title: VbsTools: VBScript
description: VBScript for Windows: IntelliSense for COM objects, diagnostics, a debugger, a cscript-compatible script host and a code library.

title: CodeGen Universal
description: Universal right-click code generator for VS Code & Antigravity IDE. Scaffold Dart/Flutter, Laravel/PHP, React, Go, Vue, Python, and custom templates in seconds.

title: Helicon
description: Open-source GUI for the Muse Code CLI inside your editor: threads in a sidebar, approvals you can read, inline diffs, session history and usage. Uses your own muse login.

title: Puzzle Break: Brain Games for Coders
description: Take a 3-minute brain break without leaving VS Code: daily logic puzzles (Crowns, Balance, Trail, Tiles), Sudoku, Lights and Nokia-style Snake with levels.
